ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 55 percent high-intensity white pixels concentrated on the distal lobes versus 45 percent low-intensity black pixels in the central and marginal areas.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, high-intensity white contiguous areas on the lateral lobes separated by a wide, low-intensity black central corridor; high-frequency mottling and stippling are present at the black-white transition boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an internal angle of approximately 50 degrees; significant vertical depth relative to the fluke lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude jagged profile along the trailing edge; pixel variations form sharp peaks and valleys, particularly dense at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Continuous convex curvature on the posterior boundaries of both lobes tapering to acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast textured clusters of roughly circular nodes localized at the distal tips; several small isolated low-intensity circular spots within the white fields.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct low-intensity linear marks intersecting to form an X-shape on the left lobe; one curved low-intensity line on the distal region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct intersecting linear scars forming an X-shape on the left lobe; crescent-shaped mark on the right lobe; heavy calcified protrusions on the distal edges.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique and identifiable geometric X-shaped pixel pattern on the left ventral lobe.
